name: Document: Brandon writes his working-with-me document
text_content:
Type: Document

The Session 1 page holds a complete working-with-me spine (eleven prompts, each with guidance on what it asks, how to answer well, and what a weak answer looks like) and a seat-specific preamble for the founder who owns the concept, the operating systems, the experience, and the public voice. Three self-exercises (values, work style placement, strengths inventory) precede the writing and are specified there. The document is completed alone, from the spine, with all answers left blank until the founder fills them. It is exchanged with the other founders; the timing of the exchange with the chef partner is open and routes to Session 7, but this founder's document can be written now.

Source: Session 1 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhd7. Positions and reasoning live on the S1 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text:
Extended by Session 16. The spine gains additions to ten prompts, stated as records to feed or rules to answer and never as content: prompt A points to the seat description's outward half and adds the seams found since; B feeds the knowledge-transfer register with dates; C states presence by service period and by week in a seat field's form, the languages held, closed-hour availability, and the consequences of commitments outside the house in general terms only; D carries the founder's draft of the interim rule and Class B preference; E adds how a range breach written as a question is to be said; F's dependency column feeds the founder load ledger; H names the seat's load line's signals expected first; I adds the post-service rule; J adds the pairing's dependencies; K is the learning agenda revisited at every reset (S16 section 9.4, P45). The protection order's four tiers are a private appendix with only the second tier's dates on the partners' page (S16 P18, P22). The issued version reaches the Maitre d before the Maitre d's first check-in with Brandon (S16 P45). Nothing in the document is written by anyone but Brandon.

Filed by Session 16 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjz6. Reasoning lives on the S16 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
